# UiLink

Navigates. Always a real `<a>`; use UiButton for actions.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | actions |
| Import | `import { UiLink } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiLink from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiLink'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/actions/UiLink.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/actions/UiLink.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` **(required)** | `string` |  | Destination. Links navigate; use UiButton for actions. |
| `color` | `UiColor` |  | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `underline` | `'always' \| 'hover' \| 'none'` | `'always'` |  |
| `external` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and says so to assistive technology. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a non-interactive, `aria-disabled` placeholder link without `href`. |

## Attributes

The `<a>` element.

## Keyboard

- Enter follows the link (native).

## Accessibility

- Underlined by default so it is not identified by colour alone.
- `external` adds `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"` and a visually hidden "opens in a new tab".
- `disabled` removes `href` and sets `role="link" aria-disabled="true"`.

## Styling

- `.vui-link`, `.vui-link__icon`
- `data-color`, `data-underline`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <UiLink href="#/foundations">{{ t('nav.foundations') }}</UiLink>
  <UiLink :href="docsUrl" external>{{ t('demo.docs') }}</UiLink>
  <UiLink href="#/forms" color="neutral" underline="hover">{{ t('nav.forms') }}</UiLink>
  <UiLink href="#/forms" disabled>{{ t('demo.disabled') }}</UiLink>
</p>
```
